_comment: Copy this to ~/Library/Application Support/session-recall/sources.json and edit.
One entry per agent. The next scan indexes it; `session-recall doctor` reports
anything wrong with it instead of silently indexing nothing.
id             required  slug used in the UI and in --agent; must not match a built-in agent
label          optional  name shown in the UI (defaults to id)
format         required  "jsonl" (one JSON object per line) or "json" (one document per file)
root           required  directory to scan; ~/ is expanded
glob           optional  file-name filter, only the suffix is used (defaults from format)
messages       json only dot path to the message array (default "messages")
role           optional  dot path to the role field (default "role")
text           optional  dot path to the message text (default "content")
time           optional  dot path to the message timestamp
cwd            optional  dot path to the project directory, read from the first record that has it
title          optional  dot path to a session title, read the same way
startedAt      optional  dot path to the session start time
updatedAt      optional  dot path to the session update time
userRoles      optional  roles that open a new turn (default user, human, prompt)
assistantRoles optional  roles appended to the current turn (default assistant, agent, ai, model, bot)
Timestamps may be epoch seconds, epoch milliseconds or ISO strings.
Text may be a string or a list of blocks where the text sits under "text".
SQLite sources cannot be expressed here; those need an adapter in src/adapters/.
